text: I just called to ask how much a cat pregnancy test costs. We just got a cat and we only wanted to know if she was pregnant. The vet asked how many months pregnant she was, which I couldn't answer because if I knew for sure, why would I ask the vet to test her? And then she got angry and raised her voice at me. Couldn't she have offered some advice or suggested other services? Even just being a consultant would have been nice. If she had spoken nicely, I would have gone anywhere, even if it was far away. Before I could finish asking, she interrupted me, getting irritated. She said she was busy with another case, but could have been calmer and explained things to me properly. Why did she have to yell at me? I didn't want to bother her at all; it's just that the person who answered the phone didn't know anything. I'm sorry to bother you, but I'd appreciate recommendations from other vet hospitals.

I felt so stupid for the question I asked her. I probably won't use your services again.
